hypotheses.justification: The statement does not mention this instance. In the proof it is used only to call `measurable_density H μH`, which needs `[SFinite μH]`. The other lemmas used (`HaarQuotient.lintegral_density_mul_eq_one` and `lintegral_withDensity_eq_of_admissible`) do not take `[SFinite μH]`. The instance is derivable from the remaining hypotheses. `hH : IsClosed (H : Set G)` and `[LocallyCompactSpace G]` give `LocallyCompactSpace H` via `IsClosed.locallyCompactSpace` (Mathlib `Topology/Compactness/LocallyCompact.lean`). `H` is second countable as a subtype of the second-countable `G`, so `SigmaCompactSpace H` follows. Mathlib's instance `IsHaarMeasure.sigmaFinite [SigmaCompactSpace G] : SigmaFinite μ` (in `Group/Measure.lean`) then gives `SigmaFinite μH` from `[μH.IsHaarMeasure]`, hence `SFinite μH`. Adding `haveI := hH.locallyCompactSpace` at the start of the proof is therefore enough, and the theorem stays true and provable without this binder.
